name: U.S. Bancorp

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (US Bancorp logo 2023 color.svg)

description: U.S. Bancorp is a bank and financial holding company whose bank subsidiary, U.S. Bank National Association, holds all $522.2B of its deposits and lends to consumers, businesses and governments through 2,075 branches in 26 states. It earns money from the spread between deposit and loan rates (net interest income $16.8B on a taxable-equivalent basis) and from fees (noninterest income $11.9B), and a large part of it is payments: card issuing, corporate and purchasing cards and merchant processing make up 26 percent of net revenue. Its other segments are Wealth, Corporate, Commercial and Institutional Banking (42 percent, including corporate trust and fund administration) and Consumer and Business Banking (31 percent).

businessLines.name: Wealth, Corporate, Commercial and Institutional Banking
businessLines.how: Lends to and holds deposits for wealth, middle-market, large corporate, commercial real estate, government and institutional clients; earns the interest spread (60 percent of segment revenue, 7,214 of 12,083, computed) plus fees: trust and custody fees charged as a percentage of assets, treasury-management fees, capital markets and underwriting fees, and brokerage and investment commissions.

businessLines.name: Consumer and Business Banking
businessLines.how: Takes deposits and lends to consumers and small businesses through 2,075 branches in 26 states, 4,428 ATMs, digital banking and intermediaries (auto dealers, mortgage banks); 82 percent of revenue is net interest income (7,248 of 8,873, computed), the rest mainly mortgage banking (gains on sale and servicing) and service charges.

businessLines.name: Payment Services
businessLines.how: Issues consumer and business credit, debit and stored-value cards, corporate and purchasing cards, and processes merchant card payments; earns interchange, annual and account fees and merchant discount net of interchange (59 percent of revenue is noninterest income, 4,359 of 7,407, computed, shown after 3.1 billion of rewards, rebates and partner payments) plus interest on card balances.

businessLines.name: Treasury and Corporate Support
businessLines.how: Not a customer business: investment portfolios, funding, capital management, interest-rate risk management and unallocated taxes.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), net income attributable to U.S. Bancorp

brands.name: U.S. Bank (U.S. Bank National Association)
brands.note: The sole bank subsidiary; holds all consolidated deposits of $522.2B at 2025-12-31.

brands.name: BTIG (Condor Trading LP and subsidiaries)
brands.note: Institutional trading, investment banking, research and brokerage firm; pending acquisition announced January 2026 for up to $1B (see whatsNext).

whatsNext.text: Acquisition of BTIG (Condor Trading LP and subsidiaries) for up to $1B: targeted $725M at closing ($362.5M cash plus 6,600,594 USB shares) and up to $275M more in cash over three years on performance targets; expected to close in the second quarter of 2026 subject to regulatory approvals. The Q2 2026 10-Q's XBRL carries a BTIG acquisition-date member of 2026-06-01, which suggests a 2026-06-01 close, but the closing text was not read.
